relay.transcript.turn.condensed.note: Used only when the model supplies no more specific segment label.

relay.transcript.turn.took.note: {duration} is already formatted, for example 31s or 2m14s. Never claim a duration when absent.

relay.transcript.turn.actions.note: {label} is the formatted count, including a trailing + when the loaded history is partial. Translate the complete plural message; do not print {count} separately.

relay.transcript.turn.completed.note: Appended to a completed condensed bar's accessible name.

relay.transcript.fold.unit.note: One complete unit per kind. shell, python and {name} are runtime/tool names and stay untranslated. The other arm formats a raw tool name; preserve placeholders and plural/select syntax exactly.

relay.transcript.fold.shell.note: shell is a runtime tool category and stays untranslated. Use the locale's number formatting and plural rules; the noun remains shell in every arm.

relay.transcript.fold.python.note: python is a runtime tool category and stays untranslated. Use the locale's number formatting and plural rules; the noun remains python in every arm.

relay.transcript.fold.more.note: Follows at most five count units and counts actions hidden by that display cap, not additional tool types.

relay.transcript.fold.failed_label.note: Screen-reader text accompanying the failure glyph; it does not claim a count.

relay.transcript.fold.partial_label.note: Explains that N+ is a minimum because earlier history has not loaded.

relay.transcript.older.failed.note: Shown beside the existing Try again action at the top of the transcript.

relay.transcript.older.load.note: Tappable row between the conversation's opening message and its newest rows when earlier messages exist but are not shown. Count-free on purpose: the number of missing messages is not known. Same wording as the desktop's ui.chat.canonical.older_history.load.

relay.transcript.older.loading.note: Announced to screen readers (status role) while earlier messages are fetched; shown beside a small progress bar. Same wording as the desktop's ui.chat.canonical.older_history.loading.

relay.transcript.older.start.note: Shown above the first message once every earlier message has been loaded; not an action. Same wording as the desktop's ui.chat.canonical.older_history.conversation_start.

relay.transcript.label.steered.note: The segment followed a steering message.

relay.transcript.label.wake.note: The segment followed a scheduled wake.

relay.transcript.label.peer.note: The segment followed a peer message.

relay.transcript.label.job.note: The segment followed a background job result.

relay.transcript.label.ask.note: The segment contains a settled operator question.

relay.transcript.label.messages.note: Used when receipts from multiple families form one quiet group.

relay.transcript.composer.queued.note: Restores the pre-redesign queued-prompt count; {count} is the number of prompts waiting, not tool calls.

relay.transcript.session.unread_refused.note: Explains that unread state could not be read and that no messages were marked read. Used by both bulk and row-level mark operations.

relay.transcript.message.show_more.note: Visible label of a small button under the person's own message when a condensed turn cuts it to three lines. Pressing it shows the whole message. Must stay short; it sits on a 32 px button.

relay.transcript.message.show_less.note: Same button once the message is open; pressing it folds the message back to three lines.

relay.transcript.message.show_more_label.role: message fold button accessible name, folded
relay.transcript.message.show_more_label.note: Screen-reader name. The visible label (relay.transcript.message.show_more) must be recognisable as the start of it. 'your message' is the message the person sent.

relay.transcript.message.show_less_label.role: message fold button accessible name, open
relay.transcript.message.show_less_label.note: Screen-reader name once open. The visible label (relay.transcript.message.show_less) must be recognisable as the start of it.

relay.transcript.bridge.provenance.note: Under an inbound Team Bridge card on the phone transcript. Heads the framed body of a message a teammate or another agent sent through Team Bridge. Must say the content comes from outside and is not trusted. Same meaning as tui.bridge_card.frame.untrusted; keep the middle dot separator.

relay.transcript.bridge.loading.note: Under an inbound Team Bridge card on the phone transcript. Shown while the phone reads the message body from the computer. Keep the ellipsis character.

relay.transcript.bridge.pending.role: bridge card body state: delivery not finished
relay.transcript.bridge.pending.note: Under an inbound Team Bridge card on the phone transcript. The message exists but has not finished reaching the user's agent yet. Not a moderation decision. Same meaning as tui.bridge_card.body.pending.

relay.transcript.bridge.held.role: bridge card body state: held for review
relay.transcript.bridge.held.note: Under an inbound Team Bridge card on the phone transcript. Moderation is holding the message for review (it can still be released or refused), so its text is not shown. No reason is ever given. Same meaning as tui.bridge_card.body.held.

relay.transcript.bridge.held_transient.role: bridge card body state: screening not run yet
relay.transcript.bridge.held_transient.note: Under an inbound Team Bridge card on the phone transcript. Screening has not happened yet; nobody has decided anything. Must not read as a moderation decision. Same meaning as tui.bridge_card.body.held_transient.

relay.transcript.bridge.refused.note: Under an inbound Team Bridge card on the phone transcript. Moderation refused the message; no reason or category is shown. Same meaning as tui.bridge_card.body.refused.

relay.transcript.bridge.not_admitted.role: bridge card body state: never admitted
relay.transcript.bridge.not_admitted.note: Under an inbound Team Bridge card on the phone transcript. The message was not delivered to this agent. Same meaning as tui.bridge_card.body.not_admitted.

relay.transcript.bridge.unavailable.note: Under an inbound Team Bridge card on the phone transcript. The body cannot be shown and there is no more specific reason. Same meaning as tui.bridge_card.body.unavailable.

relay.transcript.bridge.signed_out.role: bridge card body state: signed out
relay.transcript.bridge.signed_out.note: Under an inbound Team Bridge card on the phone transcript. Radient is the product/account name and stays untranslated. Same meaning as tui.bridge_card.body.signed_out.

relay.transcript.bridge.other_account.role: bridge card body state: other account
relay.transcript.bridge.other_account.note: Under an inbound Team Bridge card on the phone transcript. The message arrived for a different Radient account than the one signed in now. Radient stays untranslated.

relay.transcript.bridge.not_member.role: bridge card body state: left the conversation
relay.transcript.bridge.not_member.note: Under an inbound Team Bridge card on the phone transcript. The user left or was removed from the conversation, so the body cannot be read.

relay.transcript.bridge.offline.role: bridge card body state: hub unreachable
relay.transcript.bridge.offline.note: Under an inbound Team Bridge card in the phone web transcript. The computer could not reach the Radient service to read the body. The card retries by itself on a timer while it is on screen, so this says it is retrying; no user action is needed. Radient stays untranslated. Same meaning as tui.bridge_card.body.offline.

relay.transcript.bridge.deleted.note: Under an inbound Team Bridge card on the phone transcript. The sender or the service deleted the message.

relay.transcript.bridge.more_messages.note: Under an inbound Team Bridge card on the phone transcript. One card can group many messages; at most 20 are listed and this counts the rest. Preserve plural syntax and # exactly. Same meaning as tui.bridge_card.body.more_messages.

relay.transcript.jump.latest.note: Floating chip at the bottom of the phone transcript while the reader is scrolled up AND new messages arrived after they left the bottom. Pressing it scrolls to the newest row and resumes following. The chip never moves the transcript by itself. The down arrow is drawn outside this string, so do not add one.

relay.transcript.jump.latest_short.note: The same chip at 380 px and below, where the full sentence does not fit. It must read as a natural shortening of relay.transcript.jump.latest, because the full string is still the accessible name.

relay.transcript.bridge.thread_reply.note: Inside an inbound Team Bridge card on the phone transcript, on the line under the untrusted-content caution: the message is a reply inside a thread, not a top-level post. Joined with ' · ' to the time it arrived (e.g. 'Thread reply · 14:56'). Same meaning as tui.bridge_card.context.thread_reply.
